# zjm-rag

> A small open-source RAG tool for local folders. zg (zvec-grep) finds candidate files, Jev (the OpenRouter Decisions API) judges which of them contain the answer, and an LLM answers from those files only, citing their paths.

The Python library `zjm_rag` is in: stdlib only, Python 3.10+, with `index`, `find` and `ask`. `index` copies source folders into a store and builds the zg index there. `find` asks zg for up to 40 hits, groups them into at most 8 files, has Jev score each file from its path and snippets, and splits them at a threshold (0.5 by default) into accepted and rejected. `ask` sends the best three accepted files to the `claude` CLI and returns the answer with the paths it used; when no file passes, no LLM is called. zg runs locally; snippets go to OpenRouter (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`) and the chosen files' text goes to the LLM provider.

The `zjm` command runs the same operations from a shell (`zjm index`, `find`, `ask`, `doctor`), and `--json` prints the library's result as one JSON object. `zjm serve` is a local HTTP JSON API on 127.0.0.1:8765 (`GET /health`, `POST /index`, `/find`, `/ask`), and `zjm mcp` is an MCP server over stdio with the tools `zjm_index`, `zjm_find`, `zjm_ask` and `zjm_doctor` (`claude mcp add zjm -- zjm mcp`).

Install with one line: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/main/install.sh | sh`. It checks for Python 3.10+, installs zg with npm when missing, installs the package with uv, pipx or pip --user, and runs `zjm doctor`.

## WebMCP tools

This site has WebMCP tools. Both pages, [/](https://rag.cocode.dk/) and [/fa/](https://rag.cocode.dk/fa/), declare them through `document.modelContext.registerTool` (module: `/webmcp.js`). All three are read-only, take no input, read the page at call time, answer in the page language and make no requests.

- `describe`: Returns what this zjm-rag page is about, its language, its sections and the other tools, in the page language.
- `get_install_command`: Returns the one-line command that installs zjm-rag, whether it is available, and its requirements; it runs nothing.
- `list_interfaces`: Lists the four ways to call zjm-rag (Python library, CLI, HTTP JSON API, MCP server), each with whether it is available or planned, a summary, its spec link and an example if there is one.

- [README](https://github.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/blob/main/README.md): what it does, requirements, install and usage
- [zjm_rag/core.py](https://github.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/blob/main/zjm_rag/core.py): `index`, `find` and `ask`
- [Website (English)](https://rag.cocode.dk/): how it works and what exists today
- [Website (Persian)](https://rag.cocode.dk/fa/): the same page in Persian

## Specs

- [01 Library](https://github.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/blob/main/docs/lean/01-library.md): `index`, `find`, `ask`, threshold and sort options (built)
- [02 CLI](https://github.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/blob/main/docs/lean/02-cli.md): the `zjm` command with `--json` and `zjm doctor` (built)
- [03 HTTP](https://github.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/blob/main/docs/lean/03-http.md): `zjm serve`, a JSON API on 127.0.0.1 (built)
- [04 MCP and install](https://github.com/cocodedk/zjm-rag/blob/main/docs/lean/04-mcp-install.md): `zjm mcp` over stdio and `install.sh` (built)
